name: TSC Auto ID Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: TSC Auto ID Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing and service of automatic identification and data capture system products in China, Asia, the Americas, Europe, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Barcode Printers and Spare Parts; Various Label Paper of Printers and Consumables; and Company Laptops. The company offers desktop, RFID, industrial, enterprise, mobile, color label, linerless, and barcode inspection printers, as well as print engines and modules; mobile computers, RFID solutions, enterprise tablets, payment terminals, interactive kiosks, and vehicle gateways; specialty keyboards; and RFID and inkjet labels, as well …
